lītĭgātĭo , ōnis, f. litigo,
I.a dispute, quarrel (post-class. for lis, jurgium, certatio): “omissis litigationibus (al. litigatoribus),” Lact. 3, 8 init. dub. (al. litigatoribus): litigatio μάχη ἡ διὰ λόγων, Gloss. Philox.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
